messages:
lee: Quick heads-up — BigBank wants a joint POC orchestration doc and final price buckets by EOW. Can we confirm who owns the runbook and SSO/testing matrix?

jordan: I can own the arch diagram and the POC infra layout. Need to know if they require Dedicated (reserved GPU) or Hosted API for initial tests. Also SAML + egress requirements from their security team.

mia: From GTM, they want an ops handoff and a one-pager for internal procurement. Pricing question: do we quote per-token hosted pricing for the pilot or assume a Dedicated trial rate?

sam: For presales, recommend offering a 30-day Dedicated pilot credit — simpler for predictable perf. If they prefer Hosted, we can do usage cap + daily quotas. Which product tier is likely?

jordan: They mentioned strict latency SLOs, so Dedicated is the safer ask. Will check with infra on capacity windows.

nisha (EdgeCloud): Quick clarifier — BigBank's infosec will need the security questionnaire back before kickoff. FedRAMP adjacencies might be requested. Who handles detailed answers?

mia: We do the initial pass, but need SecOps sign-off on any network/egress items. @sam can you list expected questionnaire items?

sam: Sure — items we'll definitely see: data residency, encryption in transit+at-rest, key mgmt options (KMS/HSM), SSO/SAML, audit logs/retention, IAM roles, subnet/VPC peering, egress IP ranges. I'll paste a minimal checklist: 

```
- Data residency: yes/no
- TLS: TLS1.2+ required
- KMS: customer-managed ok?
- SSO: SAML 2.0, IdP metadata required
- Audit logs: 90d retention default, can extend
- Network: customer egress IPs + firewall rules
```

sam: I'll draft answers and attach.

lee: Re: runbook ownership — @jordan will own architecture/runbook, @mia will own procurement one-pager, @sam owns sec questionnaire draft. Can we lock a joint tech sync on Thursday 10:00am PT?

jordan: Thu 10 PT works for me. I'll invite infra + runtime lead.

mia: Works. I'll invite AE from BigBank and procurement.

deploy-bot: runbook-template created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-orchestration-template (auto-created) :white_check_mark:

sam: On the SSO config — here's the minimal SP metadata we need from BigBank:

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/saml">...
</EntityDescriptor>
```

sam: Also, for Dedicated pilot sizing, we need expected qps and typical prompt length. Can @nisha share their test corpus size (rough token counts)?

nisha (EdgeCloud): They'll send sample traffic next week, ~150 reqs/sec peak, avg prompt ~80 tokens, sometimes longer. Expect some data sensitivity flags.

jordan: Good — that maps to 2x M60-equivalent for baseline. I'll propose autoscale floor and burst policy.

mia: Procurement note — BigBank asks to see a sample SOW and pilot acceptance criteria. I'll reuse the standard template and attach to invite.

lee: Action items recap: Jordan=arch/runbook + infra invite; Sam=sec questionnaire draft + SSO checklist; Mia=procurement one-pager + SOW draft; Nisha=sample traffic + IdP metadata. Thursday 10am PT tech sync. Ping me here if anything slips. :thumbsup: 

jordan: Adding one blocker — BigBank legal may require our private deployment option for specific datasets. If that surfaces, we'll need pricing for Private (VPC/on-prem) + deployment lead. Flagging now.

sam: Noted — will include Private deployment delta in the pricing doc (delta to Dedicated).

lee: Thanks team. I'll convert this to a short Loom and share with BigBank if that's helpful.

mia: Please do. Loom + agenda will reduce back-and-forth.

nisha (EdgeCloud): Thanks — I'll aim to have sample traffic and IdP metadata by Tue EOD.

lee: Perfect. Closing thread for now, will post calendar invite shortly. :calendar:
